item.title: fix(copilot): restore OpenClaw guidance to agent turns (#125997)
item.summary: fix(copilot): restore OpenClaw guidance to agent turns (#125997) * fix(copilot): add OpenClaw prompt guidance Copilot append-mode system messages included credential safety, workspace bootstrap, and extra context but omitted OpenClaw delegation and reply-delivery policy. Build guidance from the final policy-filtered tool surface so visible delegated work, Skill Workshop, and source replies follow the same behavior as Codex. * fix(copilot): break prompt guidance import cycle The CI architecture gate detected a cycle through attempt-config and prompt-guidance. Isolate raw-run mode detection in a leaf module.
